answers.rationale: Protein is up; CPTAC and TCGA RNA are up. RCC holds the largest transcript share and the purity interval is above 0. The protein is surface-annotated, vital staining is level 1 with no proteome enrichment. No ccRCC lines are dependent.

No CPTAC protein record for the target. RNA is down in CPTAC, TCGA and the confirmatory cohort. CD8_T has a larger share than RCC. There is no surface record, and the normal proteome reports vital enrichment. DepMap padj is 0.404, so it fails.

Protein is down, and RNA is down in both CPTAC and TCGA. RCC has the largest share and the purity interval is above 0. The surface call is surface. IHC was not measured and the proteome shows no enrichment. No dependent lines.

Protein is down, and RNA is down in both CPTAC and TCGA, so replicated. Macrophages have a larger share than RCC. The surface call is internal. Heart staining is level 2. DepMap fails on selectivity and padj.
